query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE 
                    WHEN transaction_type IN ('deposit', 'credit_line_repayment') THEN amount
                    WHEN transaction_type IN ('withdrawal', 'credit_line_drawdown') THEN -amount
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0) as "net_balance!"
            FROM account_financial_transactions
            WHERE user_id = $1
